# ai-release-notes · Release v0.6.0

_prod · November 16, 2026 · Changes since v0.5.3_

---

Release notes can reuse earlier AI responses, and you can configure retries when a request fails.

### 🚀 New Features

- Added local response caching and provider prompt caching.
- Added configurable retries for AI requests.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed release index updates so they no longer retranslate the entire page.
- Fixed HTML entries displayed as source text and capped retry delays.
